name: Scarlett Taylor
source:
Scarlett is the older sister of [url=/c148365]Kelsey[/url], working alongside [url=/c148360]Maya[/url] at Abrams & Mulroney. Believes heavily symbolism and fate, and is quite strong at reading people - even if her moral compass is a bit skewed.
